notes: Round6 camellia: open dusty-rose petal mask and sage sepals. Complete native PixelLab pose edit, no scaling. Original anchor, support rows, frame layout/timing and held-object mask retained. Style v2: pointed dried-rose seed bulb carried head-low on two hooked root canes, its hard ivory seed point leading as the ram. One dark husk seam and one recessed slit; front and back views are an almond pointed at both ends with the sprout on top. Upper-left rim light over a dark underside plane, open limb gaps, no glow. Reviewed hop, brace, lunge and hurt timings retained. Cell dimensions, anchor and animation metadata retained; _right mirrors for left.
